hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*.ts|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*.tsx|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*.js|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*.mjs|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*.py|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*.html) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; L=graphify-out/.update.lock; find "$L" -maxdepth 0 -mmin +10 -exec rmdir {} \; 2>/dev/null; mkdir "$L" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; trap 'rmdir "$L"' EXIT; /Users/rachidsanohotmail.fr/.local/bin/graphify update . >/dev/null 2>&1
